conclusions: Device exclusive open and interface exclusive open are separate capabilities.
Cached configuration descriptor access does not require device open.
Some default-pipe requests do not require device exclusive open; standard USB state changes may still require it.
libusb tolerates device-level ExclusiveAccess but still requires successful interface open for endpoint access.
Current FX3 control callback requires device_open, so ignoring only the open result would not fix the chain.
